sc_burn_line_walks.label: burn_line
sc_burn_line_walks.detail: harness rows 4/4 PASS (present, walks hourly, burned share, off control: evidence/pv7_burn_line.json). The bar's judge clause ('a judge shown them and the whole-map day-end captures confirms a natural grass fire that moves'): this driver (not the maker) reads the front itself as a natural moving grass fire, but lone fires away from it walk as ruler-straight one-cell lanes 20-27 cells long, one cell every ~1,300 ticks along the wind (script_line_speed.log), and the day-end captures show thin straight lines across the map (screenshots/burn_line_dayend_sheet.jpg, burn_line_hourly_sheet.jpg; lanes_burn_line_walking_mask.png). Reproduced offline on the shipped model (evidence/accept_lone_fire_lane.py, 0/8).
sc_burn_line_walks.unfixed: the fix is a kernel design choice (how a single lit cell should spread under the carry: even spread until it is a front, or a widened carry), not known in the sitting; it needs a new kernel build and every check rerun
